metadata.title: How to Choose Files in Quivra | Media Converter Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
To prepare files in Quivra, choose your media files from the Library screen, then review their names before using Convert. This short guide shows where to begin and what to check in the file list.

Static screenshots with demonstration filenames; no live conversion, completed output, or speed demonstration is shown.

Quivra is a local media conversion utility. Explore the app:
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759565093
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.quivra2

#Quivra #MediaConverter #Shorts
